hero_tagline: From a relieved exhale to a flat 'well, that happened' — every sigh emoji, exasperated kaomoji, and one-click combo for the moment it's finally over. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The exhaling face 😮‍💨 is the internet's go-to sigh, and it stretches to cover a lot: relief after a close call, exasperation at yet another delay, or the flat resignation of watching something go wrong and not having the energy to react. This page collects that whole range — the relieved exhale of 😌 and 😥, the eye-rolling exasperation of 🙄 and 😒, wind-and-shrug props like 💨 and 🤷, and plain-text sigh kaomoji such as (¬_¬) for anywhere emoji don't render. If you want general exhaustion or sleepiness instead, the tired emoji page covers yawns and burnout; this one stays focused on the exhale itself, not the run-down. Grab a single face or copy a ready-made combo depending on how big the sigh is.
